description: Watches the client's Google Drive folders and brings down the new video and audio into the workspace. NO ROLE DECLARES IT AND IT IS NOT A SYSTEM PLUGIN, so it lives in this registry and ships to nobody until some role declares it
client_copy: Revisa tus carpetas de Drive y trae los videos y audios nuevos para trabajarlos.
_comment: THE ORPHAN, AND THE MANIFEST SAYS SO OUT LOUD. `roles/skills_split.py
--orphan` has been printing this name since the team pivot: no role claims
it, it is not a fallback note, and no `level: base` capability installs it,
so on a team agent it reaches nobody. Becoming a plugin does not change that
and is not meant to -- `tools/plugin_set.py` gives every agent the system
plugins, the ones behind a base capability and the ones a HIRED role
declares, and this is none of the three. It is packaged so the day a client
needs Drive as an inbox the unit is already there to declare.
IT DEPENDS ON THE google-workspace CONNECTION AND ON NOTHING ELSE. `watch.py`
reads `/opt/data/google_token.json` -- the exact file that connection's
`detects.files` names -- and the SKILL.md sends the client to the tab instead
of authenticating on its own: «Si dice que falta la conexión, el cliente tiene
que conectar Google (pestaña Conexiones) — no intentes autenticarte vos». A
plugin declares the connection; it never owns the credential.
NO PLUGIN DEPENDENCY. «El caso típico: `transcribe` el archivo» is what
usually comes next, and the SKILL.md says so in the same breath as «Lo que
